name: actor-ts-devtools-ui
//: The DevTools UI's own package (#483, under #482).  Deliberately NOT a bun
workspace: workspaces hoist, and a hoisted @angular/core in the root
node_modules would pollute the root bun.lock and Dependabot's view of a
manifest that ships with two runtime dependencies.  A separate install also
lets this package pin the TypeScript Angular supports (>=6.0 <6.1) while the
library stays on ^7.0.2 — the same split examples/*/frontend-angular already
Everything is a devDependency, which is the load-bearing claim of the
architecture clamp: no UI framework appears in actor-ts's dependencies or
peerDependencies, nothing here is installed by a consumer, and the built
bundle is embedded into src/devtools/generated/UiAssets.ts at build time.
echarts, vitest and jsdom are installed ahead of their use (#486, #487) so
the lockfile is written once for the epic rather than churned per child.
